archetypes.name: dyn-loop-evidence
archetypes.rationale: Verify exhausted repair loops preserve and validate the final post-check failure evidence.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the repair-loop state transitions after each helper edit. Confirm only supported sites route exhausted loops to the main agent, the final redacted failure log is used, and invalid or out-of-root paths fail closed without changing no-changes-stale behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
